fixture.acceptance_metric: Decimal equality of total cost at 4000 requests and the first strict specialist saving at 4001, given a passed quality gate.

taskforge_candidate.command: python3 decimal probe recorded in docs/grokbot-progress.md

taskdistill_formula_reimplementation.note: Reimplemented the published break-even in builder.py. The full taskdistill package was not executed: classifiers are macOS/Apple Silicon (mlx) and the install pulls model tooling this comparison does not need.

routellm.reason: Public controller and eval CLI take router name, strong/weak model ids, and a cost threshold. They do not accept a specialist fixed cost, a human review price, or a locked four-label id set.

frugalgpt.reason: LLMCascade optimizes a sequence of hosted LLM calls under a test-set budget. It does not price specialist training plus labeling as a fixed cost or report the first integer request after a tie.
